# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Fifty-five  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and adoptive parent  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with distinct angles and no curves. Her dark hair is streaked with gray and constantly twirled up into a hard little knot behind, secured aggressively by two wire hairpins. Despite her grim expression, a slight saving something about her mouth hints at a latent sense of humor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and firm determination who values neatness, order, and propriety. She possesses a somewhat grim and curt demeanor, often concealing her deeper feelings and affection under a stern exterior. Though she disdains sentimentality and daydreams, she has an underlying sense of humor, a capacity for deep warmth, and a strong sense of duty. Despite her strictness, she is capable of acknowledging her own mistakes and adjusting her views.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c14 P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024)_

## Goals

- To raise and train Anne Shirley to be a useful and respectable woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived an unmarred, quiet life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew, managing their homestead. Wanting a young orphan boy to assist Matthew with farm work, they arranged through acquaintances to adopt one from Nova Scotia. Due to a misunderstanding, an eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley arrived instead. Though Marilla initially insisted on returning the orphan girl, she was moved by pity and Matthew's quiet persistence, agreeing to keep Anne and raise her properly. Over the next five years, Marilla navigated the challenges of raising an unusually imaginative, talkative, and impulsive girl. She strictly corrected Anne's outbursts, taught her prayers and catechism, and oversaw her schooling and home chores. Through various incidents—including Anne's temper explosion at Mrs. Rachel Lynde, her accidental intoxication of Diana Barry, the loss of Marilla's prized amethyst brooch, and Anne's green hair mishap—Marilla learned to temper her strictness with deep affection and a newfound sense of maternity. When Anne decided to quit school after being humiliated by her teacher, Marilla wisely sought Mrs. Lynde's advice and allowed Anne a brief respite to cool down. As Anne grew into an accomplished student, Marilla supported her education, consenting to her joining the Queen's Academy preparation class and later funding her studies at the Academy in Charlottetown. During Anne's absence, Marilla felt an aching loneliness at Green Gables.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Was taunted for her dark, homely appearance as a young child by her aunt  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with John Blythe, which ended after a bitter quarrel  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Inherited her mother's amethyst brooch  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m not suffering for company. And I’m not going to keep her.  <sub>[v1 c3 P65](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0065)</sub>

> I’ve never brought up a child, especially a girl, and I dare say I’ll make a terrible mess of it. But I’ll do my best. So far as I’m concerned, Matthew, she may stay.  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

> I don't believe in pampering vanity, Anne, I'll tell you that right off.  <sub>[v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008)</sub>

> I love you as dear as if you were my own flesh and blood and you’ve been my joy and comfort ever since you came to Green Gables.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>

> We had a quarrel. I wouldn’t forgive him when he asked me to. I meant to, after awhile—but I was sulky and angry and I wanted to punish him first. He never came back—the Blythes were all mighty independent. But I always felt—rather sorry. I’ve always kind of wished I’d forgiven him when I had the chance.  <sub>[v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
